parameter_semantics: phase is high-level semantic intent selected from observable responsibility, not elapsed time: drawer_release_to_red opens/retreats and approaches red; red_grasp_transport_place closes on red and carries/descends; red_release_to_blue opens, clears red, and transits toward blue; blue_pickup approaches/closes/lifts blue. Object and destination identifiers select current observed red, blue, and red_goal relations in metres and world SE(3) poses.
output_semantics: Each slot is [dx,dy,dz,rx,ry,rz,gripper]. Translation is metres in the TCP frame frozen from the newest causal observation at chunk construction. Rotation is a relative rotation vector in radians for target orientation in that same frame. The decoder composes the relative pose with the causal chunk TCP and calls panda_kinematics.solve_ik from freshly measured joints. Gripper preserves the demonstrated scalar and common nonnegative=open, negative=close semantics. Slots represent t-1 through t+14; execution uses slots 1 through 8.

conversion_check.description: Encode demonstrated commanded-TCP FK relative to the causal chunk TCP, decode by exact SE(3) composition, solve IK from measured joints, and compare world TCP position metres, rotation radians, and gripper scalar. Rotation-vector log/exp is exact on valid encoded labels up to numerical tolerance; nonunique joints are judged only in task space.

cut_relation: Four contiguous bindings per demonstration cover [230,445), [445,620), [620,780), and [780,850), so every assigned action is supervised exactly once. This retains complete [230,470) overlap with open_drawer and [600,850) overlap with blue_insert while supplying coarse semantic phase intent.
